C1380.title: Mirai Botnet Leverages IoT Devices to Launch Massive DDoS Attacks
C1380.summary: In 2016, Mirai continuously scanned the internet and attempted to log in to IoT devices that still used default usernames and passwords. Successfully compromised cameras, routers, and other devices were enrolled into a botnet and used in high-volume DDoS attacks that disrupted major internet services, prompting a dedicated threat alert from U.S. cybersecurity authorities.
